capabilities.surface: typed optimize planning, cursor resume, and rollback policy
capabilities.format: Hugging Face and native GGUF planning records
capabilities.evidence: unit and integration tests for deterministic plans and resume state
capabilities.limitation: Execution support remains profile- and format-specific.

capabilities.surface: versioned hard constraints, soft objectives, and capability-gated plugins
capabilities.evidence: objective contract schema, deterministic identities, and plugin conformance tests
capabilities.limitation: A plugin prediction is not measured optimization evidence.

capabilities.surface: preregistered matrix, retained cells, lineage, and publication decision
capabilities.format: v2 benchmark protocol and evidence bundle
capabilities.evidence: content-addressed protocol and fail-closed publication tests
capabilities.limitation: No live v2 campaign or reference artifact is claimed in this release.

capabilities.surface: automatic candidate selection through physical mutation and evaluation
capabilities.runtime: host-specific model and optional runtime dependencies
capabilities.evidence: prior bounded research records and executor contracts
capabilities.limitation: General task quality, cross-family transfer, and deployment benefit are unverified.

capabilities.surface: repair, quantization, and runtime measurements in release cells
capabilities.format: licensed model artifacts and declared runtime profiles
capabilities.evidence: versioned protocols and host-bound prior evidence
capabilities.limitation: Measurements cannot be generalized beyond the recorded host, tool, and artifact.

capabilities.surface: unlisted architecture, mutable checkpoint, or inferred format support
capabilities.runtime: any runtime not covered by a declared capability cell
capabilities.evidence: fail-closed compatibility and artifact validation gates
capabilities.limitation: A neighboring family or successful toy fixture does not establish support.

capabilities.surface: hosted providers, live endpoints, and remote model-quality benchmarking
capabilities.evidence: provider boundary explicitly excludes execution authority and live quality claims
capabilities.limitation: No credentials, hosted service, or remote endpoint evidence is included.

capabilities.surface: clean-environment reproduction of every preregistered v2 cell
capabilities.format: licensed checkpoints, datasets, and signed bundles
capabilities.runtime: clean CPU/CUDA environments as declared by a future campaign
capabilities.evidence: reproduction protocol and required command manifest only
capabilities.limitation: The checked-in release boundary does not contain external weights, datasets, or live run logs.

model_families_and_revisions: Declare exact dense families, sizes, checkpoint revisions, and licenses before a live campaign.
Do not substitute mutable branches or unlicensed weights.
datasets_tasks_splits_and_licenses: Use held-out task or corpus splits with stable identities and license records.
Retain contamination, unavailable, and unsupported cells.
baselines_and_ablations: Run the declared v1.1 baseline and autonomous, ablation, manual, and competitor arms under equal budgets.
hardware_and_budgets: Record CPU, accelerator, memory, runtime revision, optimization budget, evaluation budget, and artifact ceiling.
metrics_and_thresholds: Record quality, size, RAM, VRAM, prompt/decode throughput, cost, optimization time, and confidence intervals.
Apply hard constraints before soft objectives and publish only when intervals clear the preregistered threshold.
seeds_and_repetitions: Use at least three campaign seeds and repeated runtime measurements per measured cell.
negative_and_unsupported_cells: Every declared cell is retained as measured, negative, unsupported, failed, or unknown with a reason.
provenance_requirements: Bind code, config, model, dataset, tool, hardware, seed, and artifact digests to every evidence record.

compatibility.policy: Unknown and unsupported combinations fail closed; verified claims are limited to the exact recorded format, model, runtime, and evidence cell.

commands: uv run --locked --extra dev pytest tests/test_v20_release.py tests/test_v2_benchmark.py tests/test_optimization_package.py tests/test_user_workflow_docs.py -q
known_skips: No live CUDA, external llama.cpp service, hosted provider, or licensed external model benchmark was run.
Package signing, publication, and clean-environment archive installation remain release-pipeline actions.
